name: supp_ac_selftest
purpose: self-test of run_supplementary_ac.py guard (not a measurement)

encoder_common.notes: constant-QP (no rate control); GOP structure = preset default; intra refresh CRA every 1 s; POC0IDR = library default (off)

psnr_definition.secondary_peak: 1023 = 2^bitdepth - 1  (FFmpeg convention, also stored in per-run JSON)
psnr_definition.bitdepth: computed on 10-bit samples of the original file vs 10-bit decoder output
psnr_definition.per_component_sequence_value: arithmetic mean over frames of per-frame PSNR
psnr_definition.yuv_combined_primary: PSNR of 4:1:1 (pixel-count) weighted mean MSE, matches VVenC YUV-PSNR
psnr_definition.yuv_combined_secondary: (6*Y + U + V) / 8 of per-component PSNRs (JVET CTC style)
psnr_definition.alignment: frame i of reconstruction vs frame i of source starting at source frame 0

BasketballPass.trailing_frame_note: last frame is an NTT DOCOMO copyright text card; never encoded

run_order: fixed: warm-up first, then shortest to longest
